comment: Blessed from the pinned engine, hand-checked to the dollar. a partnership K-1 with box 1 and box 14 code A both a 6,000 loss, and the WHOLE box 14A loss stated as deductible (-6,000). Before this unit every negative box 14A refused — /knockoutK1NegativeSeEarnings; measured here it is false and the return computes. Box 1: material participation Yes against a 10,000 basis deducts the loss in full, so income is 48,250 - 6,000 = 42,250 (the DEDUCTING variant of the box 1 loss is chosen deliberately over the suspended sibling, so the return carries the loss where the form shows it rather than looking like a wages-only return). Schedule SE: /k1SeEarnings is -6,000 - the one place it can be negative - and with no other self-employment earnings net earnings floor at 0, so SE tax is 0 and there is no deductible half; AGI is unchanged at 42,250. Standard deduction 15,750 gives taxable income 26,500; tax 2,945 = 1,192.50 + 12% of (26,525 - 11,925) on the table midpoint; total tax 2,945; 6,000 withheld leaves 3,055 overpaid. Line-identical to wages-and-k1-se-loss-suspended-single by construction: with no other SE earnings both ends of the [box 14A, 0] range floor at the same Schedule SE line 4, and what the pair locks is that BOTH inclusive ends now compute. The amount only moves a served line where there is other SE income to net against - K1NegativeSeEarningsNowCOMPUTESTest measures that against a Schedule C.
